text:
Alex C: ok folks starting handoff thread. I'm primary until 11:30pm PT (now). Quick status: no active Sev>2, but two items to surface: Grafana alert noise on token-service (flapping dashboards) and a potential coverage gap for APAC overnight on Thursday. Also verify access for PD/Grafana/AWS before you accept.

Priya P: noted. can you list exactly what perms i need for grafana? i only have viewer right now.

Alex C: Grafana: need Editor on the redwood-prod org for dashboards and Alerting -> so you can mute alerts and adjust panel thresholds. If you can't edit, you can't silence the flapping panels.

Samir: i don't have the PD escalation policy edit access — can still ack/inc but can't change escalation chains. who owns that?

Alex C: PD: you need to be part of the "oncall-admins" PD group to edit policies and respond-as for escalation. Being in the basic oncall schedule is enough to ack and escalate to next level. If you need temporary admin, request via #eng-infra with justification.

oncall-bot: Incident Bot: reminder: runbook link added for handoffs: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall/handoff-checklist (pinned)

Mateo: re: AWS console — for live mitigations we need console access to assume this role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-Responder. make sure STS assume-role is working (MFA+SSO).

Alex C: exact aws role in case you need to escalate (copying for clarity):
```
arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-Responder
```
Use the SSO link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/ (click SSO -> Redwood)

Priya P: i tried assume-role yesterday and got AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt when checking logs in prod region. is that likely missing key policy?

Jordan: yeah that usually means the KMS key policy doesn't allow the role. open a ticket to sec with the role + key id. we have a template in the infra runbook.

Alex C: For quick frictionless checks during handoff do these 5 steps (copy/paste to verify now):
1) PagerDuty: open profile -> confirm you're in oncall schedule for your timezone and you can Ack/Escalate.
2) Grafana: open https://grafana.redwood.com/d/redwood-prod/token-service -> verify you see the "Mute" button.
3) AWS: assume role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-Responder and run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
4) Logs: run `aws logs tail /aws/lambda/token-service --since 15m --region us-west-2` (or use CloudWatch console).
5) MFA/SSO: make sure device has valid SSO session for at least 2 hours.

Samir: running checks now. PD ok (in schedule), Grafana still viewer for me — can't mute. aws sts success. logs ok.

Alex C: for Grafana editor request: raise a ticket to #eng-infra with subject "Grafana Editor Request - oncall" include your SSO email and workspace role. infra will add you to the "grafana-editors-prod" group. ETA ~30-90m depending on approvals.

Priya P: if infra needs justification, say: "oncall rotation coverage for token-service alerts, able to mute flapping panels and runbook-driven dashboards".

Mateo: coverage gap: Thursday 00:00-06:00 UTC currently only one person scheduled (APAC shift unfilled). we need a volunteer or re-route to dedicated sla fallback.

Jordan: can we swap someone from EMEA to cover that block? i can take a partial swap but need someone to cover my afternoon.

Alex C: proposed short-term mitigation: set PD routing rule to escalate to the Dedicated fallback schedule for that window (requires oncall-admins to change policy). I'll file a PD change request now and tag @oncall-admins. If infra approves Grafana editor faster, you can mute noise during that window.

Alex C: small runbook pointers (essential links):
- Handoff checklist: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall/handoff-checklist
- Token-service runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/playbooks/token-service
- Grafana muting docs: https://docs.redwood.com/grafana/muting-alerts
- PD escalation guide: https://docs.redwood.com/pagerduty/escalations

Samir: i've requested grafana editor in #eng-infra (link: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/eng-infra/p12345). infra responded: need manager approval.

Alex C: OK — if manager approval will take long, do this workaround: oncall admin (someone in eng-sre) can add a temporary muting rule in the alerting config. that's faster than perms change. ping @Jordan or @Mateo to do it while this is sorted.

Jordan: I can add temporary mute now. which alert? token-service-cpu-spike and token-service-5xx-flap.

Alex C: yes those two. set mute window 2h and note in the alert comment the root cause is noisy redis metrics (not a true user-impact).

Priya P: i confirm i can now see the Editor privileges (infra added me). testing mute out.

Mateo: i've set the PD fallback rule for Thursday 00:00-06:00 UTC to DedicatedFallback. filed change in PD: https://pagerduty.com/changes/CHG12345 (leave open).

Alex C: perfect. summary for whoever accepts handoff: primary->Priya P, secondary->Samir, escalation fallback->DedicatedFallback for Thursday 00-06 UTC, active infra ticket for Grafana perms, aws role and kms note filed with sec if needed.

Priya P: taking primary now. i'm on mobile but will be at my laptop in 10. Samir you are secondary; Mateo, Jordan — thanks for the quick assists. :thumbsup:

Samir: ack. i'll monitor PD and logs for the next 2 hours.

Alex C: handing off. leaving these last notes in the runbook: added comment to handoff-checklist with when i left and perms status. if anything pops, ping @Priya P or call pagerduty. handing off thread. :wave:
